code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanUploadJob,jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,models/ToppanStage}, framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl, framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, application-prod.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos not used
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. Demo remark: SFTP and code split, SFTP permission for the api App Service. File generation for Toppan at DR3 is complete: selecting DR3 notices with the driver as offender, the letter-address filter, the fixed-width file URA-DPT-DR3-D1-<timestamp> with the admin fee, upload to Blob and the COMCRYPT encryption request, then the stage advances. Blocker: in prod sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan and COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_TOPPAN is not in sftp.upload.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:83,86), so the file does not reach the vendor under the repo configuration, while the delivery gate is bypassed so the stage still advances (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-430). Only a data file is built for DR3; PDFs only for ANL. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, open), OCMS-DF-2026-170 (admin fee, Closed). Real delivery to Toppan, SFTP permission and printing by the vendor: cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ was not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially: DR3 file generation exists, but the SFTP upload to Toppan is blocked in the prod configuration and the stage still advances without delivery. Ask URA to confirm the prod configuration and the status of OCMS-DF-2026-192

steps.step: Driver notices due for the 3rd letter (stage DR3) are picked for file generation
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage(:stage) picks notices with next_processing_stage = 'DR3', next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL and an_flag not 'Y', joined to the owner_driver row with offender_indicator = 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-614), so the recipient is the current driver. ToppanStage sets DN2 -> DR3 (14 days) and DR3 as the last stage (ToppanStage.java:22-24). getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized uses that query (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1875-1890). The Toppan upload cron is enabled in prod (cron.toppanupload.enabled=true, cron-schedules-prod.properties:62).

steps.step: Only notices fit to be mailed go into the file (valid letter address, not foreign/military/diplomatic vehicles)
steps.detail: ToppanUploadJob filters with filterByLetterAddress so only notices with letter_address 'Y' (the address from the latest check) are processed (ToppanUploadJob.java:265-272). Foreign vehicles (F) without PS-FOR are removed and PS-suspended (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1938-1972), and military/diplomatic vehicles are removed at stage RR3/DR3 and given PS-MID/PS-DIP, with no letter generated (:1974-2025). This fits 'after the check and update of particulars'; the exclusion rules are not an explicit request in the story.

steps.step: OCMS builds the data file for the printing vendor with the 3rd letter details
steps.detail: For DR3 the job names the file URA-DPT-DR3-D1-<timestamp> (ToppanUploadJob.java:280-281) and calls createRequestFileContent with agency type TOPPAN_DR3 (ToppanUploadJob.java:286-288; AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-86), which writes a 719-character fixed-width file with a header and one detail line per notice (sorted by postal code) (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:553-600). The ADM admin fee for DR3 is added to the amount payable (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1831-1842). Only a data file is built for DR3; PDFs are built only for the ANL stage (ToppanUploadJob.java:324-340). The story says PDF/data files, so the data file is enough; whether the vendor prints letters from that file: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is sent to the vendor over SFTP for printing and postage
steps.detail: The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314) and the job then requests a COMCRYPT token so the file is encrypted and uploaded to SFTP by the callback (ToppanUploadJob.java:343-350). But in prod sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86) and sftp.upload.allowedSources only has COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_LTA and COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_CES, without COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_TOPPAN (application-prod.properties:83), so ComcryptUploadProcessor blocks the upload (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-208) and the file does not reach Toppan under the repo configuration (ToppanUploadJob.java:419-430 acknowledges this). SFTP permission for the App Service and the real server state: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192 (letter cron failed, stage does not change, Ready to UAT) is related.

steps.step: Once the file is delivered, the notice stage advances (DR3 to the next stage) and the dispatch is recorded
steps.detail: confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage waits for the COMCRYPT callback to prove the file landed on SFTP, then calls updateProcessingStage (ToppanUploadJob.java:419-446); the DR3 dispatch is recorded in ocms_driver_notice (ToppanUploadHelper.java:890-895) and the next stage is read from ocms_stage_map with a CPC fallback (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1815-1819). Sebagian because while Toppan is blocked (prod, application-prod.properties:86) the delivery gate is bypassed (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-430), so the stage advances even though the file was not delivered: the system record differs from reality. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192 is not Closed (Ready to UAT). Server values: cannot verify from repo.
